title: [FEATURE REQUEST] Ability to add custom label to the Claude Code session
body:
I ofter have multipe Claude Code session opened in multiple terminals. I find this sometimes problematic to easily figure out which one is which and I have to do silly `! pwd` sometimes.  I'd love to be able to pass any string (like ticket number or whatever i need) to claude code UI and it should be visible all the time on input area. I should also be able to change the label from withing the session (via i.e. `/label` command). 

```text

╭─[ My label ]──────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ >                                                                 │
╰───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
? for shortcuts

```
author: MarcinOrlowski

top_comments.author: MarcinOrlowski
top_comments.body:
FYI: the workaround I am currently using is to have custom `/statusline` script that gives me some insights based on the local environment (repo details, work dir, extra meta files I am using etc). 

But I still  really suffer from completely useless listing of sessions that `-r` is giving - I'd really want to be able to influence the session summary - I created #5846 for that feature request so it would be best if `/label` could somehow be reflect in summary (maybe?).
